name: ghc_campaign_local_session
status: compiled and round-trip decompiled with GSC Tool 1.6.2.364; CI verifies source and bytecode hashes; lifecycle monitor is source/build validated but not injected or runtime-tested
behavior: Reuses only engine-created native split-screen players; validates the exact live primary/secondary pair against the current player entity array before session reuse and Campaign actions; centralized invalidation sets status 8, releases the active sequential drill stage, preserves only a still-valid primary alias, and clears stale secondary/player handles; the Clockwork drill ownership helper allows one global active owner at a time and requires Stage 1 completion before Stage 2; owner may change between stages; exposes Player 2 loadout helper; never spawns or clones a player. Adds a single guarded lifecycle watcher after a successful bind; it revalidates the exact native pair and Campaign aliases every 250 ms, tolerates seven consecutive transient failures, and invalidates/releases drill ownership on the eighth failure (2 seconds). It does not create or rebind players; bridge main() must be called again after status 8.
